authoring: Final dinners for Sun Nov 8 through Sat Nov 14, 2026. Sunday has no dinner. Pizza stays Monday. Shrimp scampi and Tuscan chicken are not on this week. The grocery list is the household list for the week, grouped by store section. No nutrition figures.
household: Family of five. Dinners are written for about 6 adult portions. Adults eat keto or low-carb. Kid starches are optional and listed on their own. This week has no seafood.

weeks.title: Sun Nov 8 – Sat Nov 14, 2026
weeks.groceryNote: This is the written shopping list for the week. It does not resize when you change one dinner's portions, and a swapped dinner is not added automatically. Pantry staples, salt, and pepper: check the shelf before buying. Nothing here orders food. Shrimp, lemons, zucchini, spinach, sun-dried tomatoes, and extra chicken are not on this list. Broth is not on this list either.

items.label: Boneless skinless chicken breasts, about 3 lb — already on hand for Tuesday. Check the amount and that it stays safe to cook. Do not buy more.
Italian sausage, 1 lb, no added sugar

Salad greens, 3 bags (Tuesday dinner, Wednesday dinner, and leftover salads). Check the bag size.
